name: Liferun
verdict: Liferun delivered 137 leads at a $16.08 CPL over the last 28 days, with the past 7 days showing healthy momentum as leads grew 11.11% week-over-week largely in line with an 11.18% spend increase, keeping CPL virtually flat (+0.06%). The biggest movement was Google Ads spend surging 18.69% week-over-week, though it has yet to produce recorded conversions, making Meta the sole lead-generating channel and "BWS - July - Call Campaign" the top driver at $559.80 in spend.

performance.verdict: CPL holds but Google's $527 spend produces zero conversions — a confirmed drain.

findings.text: Google Ads spent $527.29 over 28 days with 0 recorded conversions and 115 clicks — confirmed pixel/tracking failure, not ad performance.
5 overdue SOW milestones (GHL gaps, stack re-test, paid landing pages, UGC batch) remain unverified past Aug 31 — each is a scale blocker.
3-day lead signal (Sep 7–9: 6, 10, 12) vs prior 3 days (Sep 4–6: 5, 0, 0) shows Meta leads accelerating; CPL flat at ~$16 confirms efficiency holding.
GBP actions dropped -100% in the last 7 days (38 actions in 28-day window, 0 in final 7 days) — organic search presence went dark with no paid-side explanation.
GHL shows 182 contacts but only 120 opportunities created and 0 won — a 62-contact gap suggests intake leak, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Audit and repair Google Ads conversion tracking immediately; $527.29 spent with 0 conversions confirms pixel is broken, not the ads.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $527.29 over 28 days and recorded 0 conversions despite 115 clicks — this is a confirmed tracking failure, not a campaign problem. The immediate action is to audit the conversion tag in Google Tag Manager (or direct pixel) and confirm a test conversion fires end-to-end before the next spend cycle. Success is confirmed when at least one test conversion registers in the Google Ads interface. Complete by 2026-09-13.

suggestions.text: Investigate GHL intake gap: 182 contacts vs 120 opportunities — identify and close the 62-contact drop-off in the intake automation.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 182 contacts entered but only 120 opportunities were created in the 28-day window — 62 leads never entered the pipeline. This is an intake automation issue, not an ads problem. The action is to audit the GHL workflow that converts contacts to opportunities (Zapier webhook + GHL Products path) and confirm both paths are creating exactly one opportunity per contact. Success is confirmed when the contact-to-opportunity ratio reaches ≥95% over the following 7 days. Target: 2026-09-17.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP: 0 actions in last 7 days vs 38 in 28-day window — re-check on Sep 13 before assuming a permanent drop.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions went to 0 in the last 7 days after delivering 38 actions in the 28-day window — a -100% delta flagged by the system. Before escalating, verify the GBP listing is live, not suspended, and that call/direction tracking is still connected. Re-check on 2026-09-13; if actions remain at 0, escalate to an audit of the GBP profile and local SEO signals.
